fields.definition: A provider-specific attribute on a model property, such as `MapToSqlNVarChar` or `MapToPgVarchar`. It declares the parameter or column name the property binds to, the database type, type options (length, precision, scale, locale), and the optional `Required` flag. Each attribute accepts a closed set of .NET property types: either the provider's native CLR type or an explicitly supported reversible conversion (such as `ulong`, `uint`, `ushort`, and `sbyte` integer and big-endian binary representations on SQL Server, and enum underlying integer types), rejecting undeclared coercions at mapping construction time. Properties without a mapping attribute are ignored. The `Mapper` reads these attributes to build its cached compiled mapping delegates.
fields.name: Mapping attribute
